scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @cims/domain && npm run start:dev -w @cims/api
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @cims/domain && npm run build -w @cims/contracts
scripts.build:apps: npm run build -w @cims/api && npm run build -w @cims/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services && npm run build:apps
scripts.test: npm run test:domain && npm run test -ws --if-present
scripts.check:phase2: npm run check:structure && npm run check:syntax && npm run test:workflow
scripts.check:production: npm run check:structure && npm run check:syntax && npm run test:domain && node tools/check-production-baseline.mjs
scripts.check:phase4: npm run check:structure && npm run check:syntax && npm run test:domain && node tools/check-production-baseline.mjs && node tools/check-phase4-baseline.mjs
scripts.release:phase4: npm run check:phase4 && npm run release:manifest
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build -w @cims/domain && npm run start:worker:dev -w @cims/api
scripts.check:phase5: npm run check:structure && npm run check:syntax && npm run test:domain && node tools/check-production-baseline.mjs && node tools/check-phase5-baseline.mjs
scripts.release:phase5: npm run check:phase5 && npm run db:migrate:dry-run && npm run release:manifest
scripts.check:phase6: npm run check:structure && npm run check:syntax && npm run test:domain && node tools/check-production-baseline.mjs && node tools/check-phase6-baseline.mjs
scripts.release:phase6: npm run check:phase6 && npm run db:migrate:dry-run && npm run release:manifest
